boundary.evidence: self-contained CLI gate in owasp skill scripts/; wired into SKILL Step 5

ownership.evidence: JWT_ALG_NONE/COOKIE rules single source; stateless scanner

dependency.evidence: grep-battery clean — node:fs/node:path only, no web/transport

error-handling.evidence: die→exit 2 usage/IO; findings exit 1; fail-closed zero-scan/no-code-files

findings.title: inline-ignore was single-line but docs promised span-wide (multi-line cookie call ignore not honored)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: a reviewer puts the ignore on the natural line inside a multi-line call and the build still fails → they disable the gate (the noisy-gate outcome)
findings.evidence: reviewer: 4-line res.cookie with ignore on line 2 → still FAIL; ignore on the .cookie( line → exit 0
findings.resolution: suppression now honors any line in [startLine,endLine] via parenSpanEnd; multi-line-ignore test added

findings.title: # comment blanking applied to JS/TS over-blanked a #private field, masking a same-line finding
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a .js `#x` field blanks the rest of the line → a real alg:none/cookie defect on that line is silently missed
findings.resolution: gated # blanking to .py/.rb only; test added (JS #x no longer masks, Python # still stripped)

findings.title: cookie-insecure false-positives on a shared options object passed by variable
findings.question: over-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: idiomatic `const opts={...}; res.cookie(n,v,opts)` red on every call → blanket ignores/disable
findings.evidence: reviewer: variable opts → FAIL missing all flags
findings.resolution: inherent text-heuristic limit; disclosed specifically in ADR-0011 + SKILL.md, sanctioned escape = inline ignore (now span-wide); test documents both

verdict: 3 findings (1 med, 2 low); 2 fixed with tests, 1 (variable-opts) documented as limitation
